generated.as: setweight(to_tsvector('simple', title || ' ' || external_id || ' ' || coalesce(host, '') || ' ' || coalesce(user_name, '')), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(description, '')), 'B')

alerts_status.name: alerts_status
alerts_status.value: ("alerts"."status" = 'attached') = ("alerts"."case_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("alerts"."status" = 'dismissed') = ("alerts"."dismissal_reason" IS NOT NULL)

cases_closed_has_resolution.name: cases_closed_has_resolution
cases_closed_has_resolution.value:
("cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("cases"."resolution" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("cases"."closed_by_id" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("cases"."status" = 'closed') = ("cases"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)

discussion_messages_author.name: discussion_messages_author
discussion_messages_author.value: ("discussion_messages"."author_id" IS NULL) = ("discussion_messages"."falcon_comment_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("discussion_messages"."falcon_comment_id" IS NULL) = ("discussion_messages"."alert_id" IS NULL)

ignored_observables_observable_active_id.name: ignored_observables_observable_active_idx
ignored_observables_observable_active_id.where: "ignored_observables"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "ignored_observables"."observable_id" IS NOT NULL

ignored_observables_asset_active_idx.name: ignored_observables_asset_active_idx
ignored_observables_asset_active_idx.where: "ignored_observables"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "ignored_observables"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL

integrations_gap.name: integrations_gap
integrations_gap.value: ("integrations"."last_gap_at" IS NULL) = ("integrations"."last_gap_from_offset" IS NULL) AND ("integrations"."last_gap_at" IS NULL) = ("integrations"."last_gap_to_offset" IS NULL)

response_actions_one_created_idx.name: response_actions_one_created_idx
response_actions_one_created_idx.where: "response_actions"."origin" = 'created' AND ("response_actions"."state" IN ('pending', 'active', 'removing') OR ("response_actions"."state" = 'failed' AND "response_actions"."removal_requested_at" IS NOT NULL))

response_actions_falcon.name: response_actions_falcon
response_actions_falcon.value: ("response_actions"."kind" = 'falcon_ioc') = ("response_actions"."falcon_action" IS NOT NULL AND "response_actions"."severity" IS NOT NULL)

tasks_done_has_completion.name: tasks_done_has_completion
tasks_done_has_completion.value: "tasks"."done" = ("tasks"."completed_by_id" IS NOT NULL) AND "tasks"."done" = ("tasks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

timeline_entries_source_idx.name: timeline_entries_source_idx
timeline_entries_source_idx.where: "timeline_entries"."source_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "timeline_entries"."retracted_at" IS NULL

timeline_entries_occurred.name: timeline_entries_occurred
timeline_entries_occurred.value:
CASE "timeline_entries"."occurred_kind"
        WHEN 'exact' THEN "timeline_entries"."occurred_end" IS NULL AND "timeline_entries"."occurred_precision_minutes" IS NULL
        WHEN 'range' THEN "timeline_entries"."occurred_end" > "timeline_entries"."occurred_start" AND "timeline_entries"."occurred_precision_minutes" IS NULL
        WHEN 'approximate' THEN "timeline_entries"."occurred_end" IS NULL AND "timeline_entries"."occurred_precision_minutes" > 0
      END
